# CineWatch

> A modern streaming platform for Movies, TV Series, and Anime.

## About
CineWatch is a web application that allows users to browse and stream a wide collection of movies, TV series, and anime. The platform features an intuitive interface with dynamic carousels, genre filtering, search functionality, and a hero section highlighting top content.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend:** Semantic HTML5, Vanilla CSS, and JavaScript.
- **Data:** Content metadata (movies, series, anime) is loaded dynamically via JavaScript data files.
- **Streaming:** Integrates with third-party iframe embed providers (e.g., VidSrc, ZXC Stream, Vaplayer).
- **Features:** "Continue Watching" tracking using local storage, favorites list, detailed modals, and a responsive mobile-first design.

## Navigation & Structure
- `/index.html`: The main homepage featuring the hero banner, top 10 lists, and genre rows.
- `/admin.html`: Administrative dashboard for managing content.
- `/movie.js`: Core frontend logic, UI interactions, modal handling, and streaming integration.
- `/*-data.js`: Data source files containing the content catalog.

## Purpose
The primary purpose of this site is entertainment, providing users with a fast, accessible, and seamless viewing experience across multiple media types.
